source_question: Among adult ICU patients with sepsis, what is the effect of crystalloids plus albumin versus crystalloids alone, initiated within 24 hours of ICU admission, on 28-day all-cause mortality?

target_trial.population: Adults with sepsis admitted to ICU
target_trial.treatment: Crystalloids plus albumin within 24 hours of ICU admission
target_trial.comparator: Crystalloids without albumin within 24 hours of ICU admission
eligibility_criteria: Sepsis diagnosis at or within a defined window of ICU admission
First qualifying ICU admission for the hospitalization
No albumin or crystalloid administration recorded before ICU admission (index event)
target_trial.assignment_procedure: Not randomized; treatment arm (crystalloids plus albumin vs. crystalloids alone) is determined by the treating clinician's choice within the 24-hour grace period after ICU admission (observational target-trial emulation, not an RCT).
target_trial.censoring_strategy: Administrative censoring at the earlier of end of the observed data (observation period) or 28 days after time zero, for anyone who has neither died nor been observed for the full follow-up window.
target_trial.analysis_strategy: Intention-to-treat analog: treatment status is fixed by exposure within the 24-hour grace period and not updated afterward; a later crossover between arms is not accounted for.
target_trial.treatment_value: Crystalloids plus albumin, initiated within 24 hours of ICU admission
target_trial.comparator_value: Crystalloids alone, no albumin within 24 hours of ICU admission

design_constraints: Align eligibility, treatment assignment, and start of follow-up to prevent immortal-time bias
Use only covariates measured before or during the predefined baseline window
Do not promote text-matched concepts to executable concept sets without human validation
